primitives.description: PVC regrind fines bridging in the crammer feed throat / funnel. Fines pack under crammer pressure and form an arch that restricts gravity feed into the screw. Symptom signature: crammer amp spike (intermittent, ≥40% above steady-state), secondary Zone 1 temp depression (throughput-driven, not heater failure).

canonical_acoustic_profile.note: elevated crammer rattle at crammer resonance frequency

primitives.canonical_action_summary: Reduce crammer to idle, rake feed throat with brass rod (3 passes) to break the fines arch, restore crammer speed. Verify crammer amp normalization before leaving.

canonical_shadow_actions.rejection_rationale: Full halt unnecessary at escalation_state 2. Bridging is recoverable without stopping the screw. Halt introduces cold-plug risk and ~20 min restart penalty.
Increasing Zone 1 setpoint masks root cause. Temp drop is a throughput effect — fix the feed flow, temp self-corrects. Setpoint chase risks overshoot once bridge clears.
